description: Source code for a wizard that generates DTA payment order files, including classes for DTA record segments and a wizard interface to create DTA files based on payment orders.

classes.name: Record
classes.description: Abstract base class representing a line (record segment) in a DTA file, with subclasses for specific segment types.

classes.name: RecordGt826
classes.description: Represents a BVR type record segment (chapter 4.2).

classes.name: RecordGt827
classes.description: Represents an Swiss internal bank record segment (chapter 4.3).

classes.name: RecordGt890
classes.description: Represents a total sum record segment (chapter 4.8).

methods.name: trim_string
methods.description: Normalizes and trims a string for encoding.

methods.name: _create_dta
methods.description: Generates the DTA file content from a payment order.

methods.name: c_ljust
methods.description: Left-justifies a string to a specified size, handling encoding.
